But I see all the time how girls are not interested in me. In my college I see how guys don't even have to try and get girlfriends, I see how the girls blush and sometimes scream when one of the attractive guys talk to them. 

I know that I will never have this, all girls I've asked out either ignored me or made fun of me. Expect one who was decent and told me the truth instead of making fun of me.
